name: The Hood

abilityDetails.Hex: Süresi dolduğunda enerji hasarı patlaması verir.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Fateseal: Uygulandığında hedefteki tüm buff'ları Nullify eder ve aktifken yenilerinin kazanılmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.

signatureAbility:
Dark Dealings
The Hood becomes Immune to all Stun effects. Firing a Bullet while Invisible has a [25 - 45]% chance to Steal 10% of the opponent's current Power, gaining twice that amount in the process.

abilitySections.title: Hex Pistols - Loaded Bullets:
content: The Hood's Bullets Persist from fight to fight within a Quest.
Make the opponent Miss while Invisible: Load 1 Bullet(s) when the Invisibility ends.

abilitySections.title: Hex Pistols - Medium Attacks & Special 2
content: 100% chance to Fire a Bullet and inflict a stacking Hex, lasting 12 seconds. Each Hex deals a burst of [4,986.5] Energy Damage when it expires and is Refreshed when a new Hex is gained.

abilitySections.title: Dash Back and Hold Block for 1.2 Seconds.
content: 100% chance to gain an Invisibility Buff lasting 8 seconds.
When Ending: Invisibility goes on Cooldown for 6 seconds.
While Active: Hood's Attacks gain +[775.64] Critical Damage Rating and ignore 75% Armor Rating and Block Proficiency.
While Active: Incoming attacks have a 120% chance to Miss. Each time the opponent Misses an attack, this Miss chance is decreased by a flat 20% until the Invisibility ends.

abilitySections.title: Critical Hits
content: 100% chance to inflict a non-stacking Stagger Passive lasting 5 seconds. When a Staggered opponent gains a Buff, all Buffs triggered at the same time are Nullified.
When this Stagger ends, it inflicts [1,495.95] direct damage on the opponent and heals The Hood for a matching amount.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Refresh the duration of all Personal Bleed and Fate Seal effects Hood has applied to the Opponent.
Cause all Hexes to Expire immediately, with +100% Potency.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: 100% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff, causing [14,959.5] Energy Damage over 7.5 seconds.
If this Shock expires after lasting its full duration, 100% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff, lasting 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% Chance to apply a Fate Seal to the opponent, Nullifying all Buffs, and prevents any new Buffs from activating for 6.5 seconds. While this Fateseal is active the opponents Ability Accuracy is reduced by 65%.
At the end of the attack, activate Invisibility.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: +[7,479.75] Attack Rating for each full bar of Power the opponent has.
100% chance to inflict Bleed, dealing [10,970.3] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Dark Dealings
content: The Hood becomes Immune to all Stun effects. Firing a Bullet while Invisible has a [25 - 45]% chance to Steal 10% of the opponent's current Power, gaining twice that amount in the process.
